rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, then retrieved recent orders to identify the correct laptop. They confirmed the specific item and proposed an exact replacement matching the user’s requested specs. Before making any changes, the agent stated the exact exchange details and sought explicit confirmation. After the user confirmed, the agent executed the exchange using the correct order and item IDs, with the appropriate new variant, and reflected the correct price difference and refund to the original payment method. Final information provided (exchange submitted, refund amount, return instructions) was consistent with tool outputs and policy. No unsupported claims or policy violations were observed.
